function.header_comment:
/******************************************************************************
 * VarDateFromI1 (OLEAUT32.221)
 *
 * Convert a VT_I1 to a VT_DATE.
 *
 * PARAMS
 *  cIn      [I] Source
 *  pdateOut [O] Destination
 *
 * RETURNS
 *  S_OK.
 */
